camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeSlowLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --SQLHASH U2FsdGVk0000 --EndTime '2020-06-18T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2020-06-17T16:00Z' --NodeId 'rn-p1fm78s90x50000' --DBName testdb
description_en: This API is used to view the slow query log details of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看实例的慢日志明细
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-slow-log-records --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --sql-ha-sh U2FsdGVk0000 --start-time 2020-06-17T16:00Z --end-time 2020-06-18T16:00Z --db-name testdb --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --node-id rn-p1fm78s90x50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610396.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the SQL statement. The ID is used to obtain the slow query logs of the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 慢日志统计里的SQL语句唯一标识符，可用于获取该SQL语句的慢日志明细
parameters.name: sql_ha_sh

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，最大不能早于当前时间30天。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.**

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要晚于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid value: 30 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：30~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node.

This parameter is available only for instances that run RDS Cluster Edition. You can specify this parameter to query the logs of a specified node. If this parameter is not specified, the logs of the primary node are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
<notice>该参数仅适用于集群版实例，可以选择查询指定节点日志。若不传该参数，默认返回主节点日志。></notice>
parameters.name: node_id
